BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

BitGo is looking for a Product Designer to help shape the next generation of fintech experiences for institutional clients. You’ll join a growing Design team and work cross-functionally to define, build, and refine the products at the core of BitGo’s Platform. As a Product Designer at BitGo, you’ll work end-to-end—from early definition and vision through execution and launch. You’ll be a passionate advocate for users, balancing business goals with real user needs, and bringing bold ideas to life in a fast-paced environment. You’ll have a direct impact on major product surfaces during a key growth phase for the company. We operate with the agility of a startup and the stability of an industry leader—offering a rare opportunity to tackle complex, high-impact problems in modern finance.

Responsibilities:

• You will lead digital product design projects from research to conception to launch
• Participate in all aspects of the design process (research, ideation, design, and user testing)
• Convey user needs through personas, journey maps, user flows, wireframes, and prototypes
• Organize and lead workshops, design reviews, user interviews, and internal lessons
• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and advocate for design excellence
• Maintain and evolve toolkits, design systems, and brand collateral
• Contribute to the overall growth, productivity, and culture of the BitGo design team
• Work with other designers to expand the BitGo design system

Required:

• 5+ years of experience designing web-based and mobile software
• Experience scaling or managing applications with a large retail base
• Deep understanding of the product design process, design thinking, design tools, and methodologies
• Ability to build user empathy and translate business understanding into beautiful, intuitive designs
• Humble yet able to defend design decisions using data, a solid design philosophy, and creative process
• A knack for visualizing complex data or user processes through diagrams and elegant interfaces
• Strong command of layout, iconography, typography, and information architecture
• A passion for exploring AI and LLMs to incorporate into your process
• Portfolio showcasing case studies and process behind consumer applications

Nice to have:

• Experience working in and passion for digital assets and Web3 technologies
• Participate in the greater design community through speaking, writing, hosting events, and showcasing work
• Knowledge of front-end development languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, etc.
• Experience building UI libraries and managing design systems

Why BitGo

Transforming financial markets requires bold thinking, technical excellence, and a deep sense of ownership. At BitGo, you’ll join a team that values craftsmanship, transparency, and high standards—and you’ll have the opportunity to shape critical product surfaces used by leading institutions around the world.

We’re building the infrastructure for the next era of finance. Joining BitGo means being able to look back and say you were part of the team that moved an industry.

Here are some of the benefits of working at BitGo:

• Competitive salary
• IT equipment support for work
• Meal & Commute allowance
• Medical Insurance
• Attractive Well-being allowance (comprises of medical, wellness and fitness aspects)
• Snacks : on-the-house in the Bangalore office
• Great/Talented workforce to learn and grow with

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you’ll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed finance.

Note: This role requires five-day in-office.
